note: Both sets cover the same core drivetrain facts (rated rotor/generator speeds, gearbox ratio, generator efficiency and inertia, driveshaft spring and damping constants, brake torque and time constant, gearbox frictional losses) with accurate values, units and supporting quotes. Set A adds prose-sourced variants (e.g., generator electrical efficiency, brake time lag, driveshaft linear spring/damping constants) while Set B repeats the table-sourced variants, but the underlying facts and coverage are essentially identical. Both sets duplicate nearly every fact by stating it once under a component name and once under the turbine name, and both omit secondary facts such as the DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft generator inertia (5,025,500 kg•m2) and the linear-ramp brake engagement description.
remarks: Both extractions pair each table row with a near-identical prose claim under the turbine entity, creating systematic duplication. Both also leave out the DOWEC comparison values (0.35 MW loss at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power, 5,025,500 kg•m2 equivalent low-speed-shaft generator inertia) and the note that FAST/ADAMS use a linear ramp to full braking over 0.6 s; the driveshaft natural frequency is stated only as 'same as the RECOFF turbine model' with no numeric value, so its absence is not a fault.
